import numpy as np
from itertools import combinations

def add(a,b):
    out=dict(a)
    for m,v in b.items(): out[m]=out.get(m,0)+v
    return {m:v for m,v in out.items() if v!=0}
def cmi(x,y,z): return {x|z:1,y|z:1,z:-1,x|y|z:-1}
ING = add(add(add(cmi(1,2,4),cmi(1,2,8)),{4:1,8:1,12:-1}),{1:-1,2:-1,3:1})
C46 = add(ING, cmi(4,8,2))
C = np.zeros(16)
for m,v in C46.items(): C[m]=v

# projection: for subset mask m, cell index = bits of (x & m) remapped to 0..2^popcount-1
def proj(m):
    bits=[b for b in range(4) if m&(1<<b)]
    P=np.zeros((1<<len(bits),16))
    for x in range(16):
        k=0
        for i,b in enumerate(bits):
            if x&(1<<b): k|=1<<i
        P[k,x]=1
    return P
PROJ={m:proj(m) for m in range(1,16)}

def c46_grid(gs,bs,s,t):
    G,B=np.meshgrid(gs,bs,indexing='ij')
    Cc=1.0-G-B
    ok=(Cc>=0)&(G>0)
    n=G.size
    D=np.zeros((16,n))
    D[0]=G.ravel()/2; D[15]=G.ravel()/2
    D[s]+=np.where(ok.ravel(),B.ravel(),0)
    D[t]+=np.where(ok.ravel(),Cc.ravel(),0)
    val=np.zeros(n)
    for m in range(1,16):
        cells=PROJ[m]@D          # (ncells, n)
        with np.errstate(divide='ignore',invalid='ignore'):
            H=-(cells*np.log2(np.where(cells>0,cells,1))).sum(axis=0)
        val+=C[m]*H
    val=np.where(ok.ravel(),val,np.inf)
    return val,G,B

target=-0.113302
best=[]
ng=480
gs=np.arange(1,ng)/ng
for s,t in combinations(range(16),2):
    bs=np.arange(0,ng+1)/ng
    val,G,B=c46_grid(gs,bs,s,t)
    i=np.unravel_index(np.argmin(val),val.shape)
    best.append((val[i],s,t,G[i],B[i]))
    j=np.unravel_index(np.argmin(np.abs(val-target)),val.shape)
    best.append((val[j],s,t,G[j],B[j],"closest"))

UNIT: GATE for "is there a PUBLISHED repair of the BCWW (4.6) inequality?". Your verdict decides whether a computation run happens: a wrong GATE_CLEAR is expensive, a wrong REPAIR_FOUND kills the run.

BACKGROUND (settled): BCWW = Bao-Cao-Walter-Wang, arXiv:1507.05650 v2 (JHEP 2015). Eq. (4.6): L = S(ABD)+S(ABC)+S(BCD)-2S(BD)-2S(BC)+S(CD)-S(AD)-S(AC)-S(AB)+2S(B)+S(A) <= 0 = -[Ingleton(A:B;C,D) + I(C:D|B)], Ingleton(A:B;C,D) := I(A;B|C)+I(A;B|D)+I(C;D)-I(A;B). Falsified elsewhere (settled, not your concern). QUESTION: has anyone since 2015 PUBLISHED a repaired version — any statement "Ingleton(A:B;C,D) + (weighted sum of CMI/MI terms) >= 0" intended for GENERAL 4-party classical or quantum states, in this pairing, in the holographic-entropy-cone / quantum-cone literature?

VERDICT RULES. REPAIR = a dated publicly archived paper (arXiv eprint or published) stating/conjecturing/proving such a general-state inequality in the BCWW lineage. NOT a repair: (a) pre-2015 classical non-Shannon inequalities (Dougherty-Freiling-Zeger etc. — predate BCWW; mark NOT_A_REPAIR with reason); (b) claims restricted to special state classes ONLY (stabilizer / holographic graph models / pure / Gaussian) — if a paper has both, it counts, quote both parts; (c) our own unpublished corpus objects (Q36, F1, F2); (d) surveys merely citing BCWW.

1. Semantic Scholar citations API (paginate): https://api.semanticscholar.org/graph/v1/paper/arXiv:1507.05650/citations?fields=title,year,abstract,externalIds&limit=1000 (add &offset=...). 2. Same for arXiv:2006.16292, arXiv:1903.09148, arXiv:2112.00763.
3. arXiv API queries: http://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query=all:%22Ingleton%22+AND+all:%22entropy%22&max_results=100 and variants ("Ingleton inequality", "four party entropy inequality quantum", "holographic entropy cone Ingleton"). Save raw XML to out/raw/.
4. Read inputs/inbox/dir3-F-A.json (traveled with you; dated 2026-08-13 area sources list) — check its UNVERIFIED GAPS items touching Ingleton repairs. inputs/inbox/dir3-register.md = our R1 for orientation only.
5. SECONDARY (DFZ basis pin): fetch arXiv:1104.3602 (Dougherty-Freiling-Zeger, "Non-Shannon Information Inequalities in Four Random Variables") full text (try https://arxiv.org/e-print handles export; or the abs page + any HTML render). If the paper parametrizes its inequalities by a list of exactly NINE information quantities (CMIs/MIs), transcribe the nine VERBATIM in the paper's slot order into out/dfz_basis.md, then cross-check this anchor (8 of 9 corpus slots pinned): slots {1:I(A;B|C), 2:I(A;B|D), 4:I(B;C|A), 5:I(C;D), 6:I(A;D|B), 7:I(B;D|A), 8:I(A;B) coeff -1, 9:I(A;C|B)} + unknown slot 3; corpus vectors C0=(1,1,0,0,1,0,0,1,0)=plain Ingleton, Q36=(1,1,0,1,1,1,1,1,0). Report which slots agree and the paper's slot 3. If unreachable, record what you saw.

DELIVERABLES (create empty early, append as you go — crash safety is graded):
- out/sources_swept.json — [{id, title, year, how_found, url_fetched, date_checked, verdict: REPAIR|NOT_A_REPAIR|UNCLEAR, reason, quote?}].
